answer: Because a missed heartbeat forfeits the epoch, the thread log exposes the live set and the reef audit records each lapse. Keeping 202 aliases alive thus means 202 heartbeats per window from origins that each have to pass the onyx quota, which is a recurring infrastructure bill. Challenges are issued only to identities that posted a heartbeat within the last 258 seconds, and heartbeats are themselves rate limited per network origin. That is 17 dollars per alias. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
